name: Compile measures from dsistudio tractmeasures datatype
summary: Compiles per-tract DSI Studio tractmeasures (stat.txt files) from many subjects into one tsv with one column per tract and subject, session and tag columns using pandas; a group-analysis utility.
description: For each input, reads the DSI Studio per-tract statistics files (*.stat.txt; tracts with *.no_result.txt get NaN), builds a table of measures by tract, adds subjectID, sessionID and tags from the input metadata and concatenates all subjects. Use it to collect DSI Studio autotrack measures across a project for statistics.

inputs.description: DSI Studio tractmeasures directories of several subjects, each holding one stat.txt (or no_result.txt) file per tract.

outputs.description: Single tsv (tractmeasures/tractmeasure.tsv) with rows per measure and subject, one column per tract, plus subjectID, sessionID and tags.
